name: Mary
summary: A virgin of Nazareth, engaged to Joseph, whom the angel Gabriel told she would bear the Son of God. She gave birth to Jesus in Bethlehem and stood by His cross.

key_moments.title: Told She Will Bear Jesus
key_moments.description: The angel Gabriel told Mary she had found favour with God and would bear a son named Jesus. She asked how this could be, then called herself the Lord's handmaid and agreed.

key_moments.title: Visiting Elisabeth
key_moments.description: Mary hurried to see her cousin Elisabeth, and Elisabeth's baby leaped at her greeting. Mary praised the Lord and stayed about three months.

key_moments.title: Gives Birth to Jesus in Bethlehem
key_moments.description: In Bethlehem Mary gave birth to her firstborn son and placed Him in a manger. When the shepherds came, she treasured all of this and thought it over in her heart.

key_moments.title: Stands at the Cross
key_moments.description: Mary stood near the cross of Jesus. Seeing her and the disciple He loved, Jesus gave them to each other as mother and son.

key_moments.title: Praying With the Disciples
key_moments.description: After Jesus was taken up, Mary the mother of Jesus prayed together with the apostles, the women and His brothers in Jerusalem.
